items.title: PHP2Shell: Using AWS Transform to move legacy PHP onto a patched runtime
items.summary: Teams on PHP 8.1 or older can't patch the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) in place. Learn how to use AWS Transform continuous modernization to find legacy PHP, upgrade it to PHP 8.4 or 8.5, validate it on a patched runtime, and then patch and restart the runtime to remediate the CVEs.
items.creator: Armando Barrales
